title: Financial Accounting Specialist
description:
**Some careers shine brighter than others.**


If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support, and rewards that will take you further.


HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.


We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of **Financial Accounting Specialist**

  

  

**In this role, you will:**

* This role can wither be an individual contributor who will be a key team member in the Process Re\-engineering team who will drive solution architecture and delivery across partner teams in Financial Accounting.
* Establish yourself as a Transformation and Automation Subject Matter Expert to help Financial Accounting become “Future Ready Financial Accounting”.
* Independently develop \& deliver work packets for project/program management teams, internal process and business, external vendors, delivery partners and subject matter experts in support of cloud, automation and related deliverables.
* Working collaboratively to identify standardization, simplification and opportunities within Financial Accounting and PAN HSBC initiatives.
* Perform business analysis activities which entails in\-depth understanding of existing process activities; preparing end to end process mapping in tools like Case wise/Visio/ARIS.

  

* Documentation of all projects related artifacts as per Change Framework. Build a roadmap and synergies between End User Computing remediation and Financial Accounting and HSBC level automation initiatives
* Consult, mentor and guide fellow associates on more than two tools like JIRA, Xceptor, Appian, ARIS, Alteryx, Python, Tableau, Power BI, Fusion Insights and Qlik.
* Contribute towards the agile way of working by leading Scrum related ceremonies and artefacts like Daily Stand\-Up Meetings, Maintain Kanban, Requirements Back Log, Burn Down Charts etc.

**To be successful you will:**

* Minimum 2 years of relevant experience in process re\-engineering, automation, or data science is required for this role.
* Ability to understand and analyze Financial Accounting related data and reports with the ability to lead discussions aiming to improve and optimize existing business processes.
* Identify opportunities to apply design led thinking approach to existing business problems to arrive at class leading solution leveraging existing or new technologies.
* Perform in\-depth analysis on Financial Accounting related datasets to identify data lineage and process related improvements.
* Advanced knowledge in project management and corresponding mapping to Change Framework, Certification in Project Management, or in Agile.
* Advanced end to end working knowledge in two or more automation, workflow \& visualization tools..
* Advanced end to end working knowledge in at least one tool being used across the Bank for process modelling and mapping, E.g. Case wise, BPMN notation.
* Experience implementing governance and solution approaches that have a direct impact on End User Computing.

  

You’ll achieve more at HSBC
